question: Among players who are either the tallest or shortest in the database and have a weight under 130 pounds, find the top 10 by penalties score. Return their full names.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE (p.XCL_126 = (SELECT MAX(XCL_126) FROM Player)
   OR p.XCL_126 = (SELECT MIN(XCL_126) FROM Player))
   AND p.XCL_127 < 130
ORDER BY pa.XCL_157 DESC
LIMIT 10
